name: anionex/vision-skills
description: A skill for agent vision work: analyzing images, running OCR, grounding GUI elements, and working from screenshots. It pairs the skill instructions with local vision client and proxy tooling so an agent can call a user-configured vision model.
install: npx skills add Anionex/agent-vision-toolkit --skill vision-skills -a codex -g --copy -y (per-agent variants in README and AGENT_INSTALL.md), plus a three-step manual install.
